300.summary: News Around the World Poland and US sign statement on defence industry cooperation — Notes from Poland Fedir Kryshtovskyi 11 November 2026 13:27 --> Poland and the United States signed a statement of intent in Washington to strengthen cooperation between the defence industries of the two countries.
300.body: News Around the World Poland and US sign statement on defence industry cooperation — Notes from Poland Fedir Kryshtovskyi 11 November 2026 13:27 --> Poland and the United States signed a statement of intent in Washington to strengthen cooperation between the defence industries of the two countries. The document was signed by Polish Minister of National Defence Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz and his US counterpart Pete Hegseth, Notes from Poland reports . Production and maintenance in Poland According to Kosiniak-Kamysz, the statement is intended to help ensure that more US weapons are manufactured and serviced directly in Poland, including through technology transfers. Hegseth noted Poland’s high defence spending and its purchases of US equipment, including Abrams tanks, F-35 fighter jets, Apache helicopters and Patriot air defence systems.

300.title: US, Poland to sign declaration on defence industry cooperation
300.summary: US, Poland to sign declaration on defence industry cooperation US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth announced on Tuesday that he and Polish Defence Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz would sign a declaration of intent aimed at expanding and accelerating bilateral defence industry cooperation.
300.body: US, Poland to sign declaration on defence industry cooperation US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth announced on Tuesday that he and Polish Defence Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz would sign a declaration of intent aimed at expanding and accelerating bilateral defence industry cooperation. X/@MON_GOV_PL Speaking at the start of their meeting at the Pentagon, Hegseth praised Poland as a model NATO ally, citing its commitment to spending nearly 5 percent of GDP on defence and its efforts to build one of Europe's strongest armies. The Polish minister also stressed the importance of closer defence industry cooperation in maintaining technological and military capabilities, warning that Russia's aggression against Ukraine was intensifying and increasingly posing a threat to NATO member states. Hegseth said he fully supported Poland's objectives of strengthening the US military presence on its territory and deepening bilateral defence cooperation. (PAP) mj/jch

600.title: Polish ex-Olympic chief accused of misusing basketball league funds
600.summary: The suspect has previously been charged as part of an investigation into a cryptocurrency-exchange scandal Polish prosecutors have accused the country’s former Olympic committee chief of misusing over 1 million zloty (€227,000) in basketball league funds to pay for private hotel stays, restaurant bills and international flights by executives.
600.body: The suspect has previously been charged as part of an investigation into a cryptocurrency-exchange scandal Polish prosecutors have accused the country’s former Olympic committee chief of misusing over 1 million zloty (€227,000) in basketball league funds to pay for private hotel stays, restaurant bills and international flights by executives. Poland's National Prosecutor's Office said on Tuesday that Radosław P. (full name withheld due to Polish privacy laws), who was the head of Polish Basketball League before becoming president of the country's Olympic Committee in 2023, allegedly ordered employees to record personal expenses as official business costs. "Polish sport's money is not a private holiday fund for executives," Waldemar Żurek, Poland's Justice Minister, wrote on X. Żurek said the charge is part of a broader investigation into suspected financial misconduct involving the Polish Olympic Committee (PKOl).
